text:
jordan: Hey team — customer (VeriSafe) says objects with TTL=7d are still searchable after 14d. They need an export for compliance tomorrow, this is urgent. Request ID from their repro: `req_8a7f3b2c`. Can we confirm whether this is a retention enforcement bug or an index visibility lag?

ashley: Thanks — can you drop the object ids or a sample query? Also which retention config does the tenant use (default vs tenant override)? :eyes:

jordan: Sample object ids: `obj_9c1a`, `obj_b3f4`, `obj_c22e`. Tenant has a custom retention override set to 7 days (confirmed in Console > Data > Retention).

mike: Quick check: deletion pipeline marks tombstones in storage then async indexer removes from search. If tombstone write succeeded but indexer backfill stalled, objects may still appear in search results. Can you share the `storage_delete` log lines for those ids?

jordan: Pasting minimal repro steps customer ran:
```
# naive repro used by customer
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"id":"obj_9c1a","data":"x","ttl":604800}'
# wait 14d
curl "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/obj_9c1a"
# returns 200 and body present (unexpected)
```

ashley: Can you run an internal check for tombstone presence? e.g. `SELECT deleted, deleted_at FROM blobs WHERE id IN ('obj_9c1a','obj_b3f4')` and paste results. If deleted=true and deleted_at >7d ago then indexer is suspect.

jordan: From quick DB check (redacted): `obj_9c1a -> deleted=true, deleted_at=2026-03-01T12:03:21Z`; `obj_b3f4 -> deleted=true, deleted_at=2026-03-02T09:11:05Z`.

mike: That confirms tombstones exist. Next suspect: indexer consumer crashed or HSM/KMS issues prevented tombstone signing? Check indexer consumer logs: `kubectl logs deployment/indexer -n storage --since=48h | grep obj_9c1a`

sre-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-3145 for retention visibility gap (assigned to eng-infra).

ashley: Also check audit log entries for delete operations to ensure KMS didn't return 403 during tombstone write. `aws-kms` return code would show in `audit.delete_attempts` with `status`. Any 403/5xx around those deleted_at times?

mike: I pulled logs — no KMS 403s. Indexer crashed on 2026-03-03 03:20 UTC (OOM) and auto-restarted, but backlog replay was incomplete for about 22 hours. That matches the window. Root cause for OOM is tracked separately.

jordan: Customer wants assurance their compliance export won't include these records. What's the remediation timeline?

ashley: Short term: we can run a forced reindex of tombstones for that tenant and run a scoped purge from search. Command (internal): `POST /internal/indexer/replay?tenant=verisafe&from=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z` — will reconcile tombstones and delete search docs. Expected impact: ~15min to an hour depending on backlog.

legal-ops: Please put VeriSafe on litigation-preserve mode until we confirm export clean. Set preserve flag on tenant and snapshot audit logs. We need the export window and customer point of contact.

jordan: Added preserve flag via Console, export scheduled for tomorrow 17:00 UTC. Contact: emma@verisafe.com.

mike: I'm kicking off the replay now. I'll paste job id and progress. Job id: `replay_job_20260309_42`. Monitoring logs: `kubectl logs job/replay-job-42 -n storage`.

sre-bot: Replay job `replay_job_20260309_42` started by mike at 2026-03-09T14:12:00Z.

mike: Update: replay processed tombstones up to 2026-03-04T12:00Z (~88% of backlog). Expected finish in ~18 minutes.

ashley: After replay completes, I'll run verification queries: `GET /internal/search/verify?tenant=verisafe&sample=true` and cross-check count vs storage. Will confirm when done.

jordan: Customer updated: they saw the objects removed from UI after 10min, but want written confirmation before export.

mike: Replay finished. Job status: success. Reindex logs show `removed_from_index: ['obj_9c1a','obj_b3f4','obj_c22e']`.

ashley: Verification done: search sample shows 0 results for those ids, storage tombstones remain (expected), audit log entries for delete present. I'll attach the verification snapshot to the ticket.

legal-ops: Received snapshot, release litigation-preserve after export completes and legal confirms. For now, approved to proceed with export.

jordan: I'll update the customer and attach the verification snapshot + job id. Thanks all. :tada:

ashley: Follow-ups: (1) track indexer memory leak fix with eng-infra (INC-2026-3146), (2) add monitoring alert for indexer backlog > 1h, (3) update runbook with forced replay steps for tenant-scoped reindex.

mike: I'll take 1 and 2. Created ENG-2026-890.

jordan: Closing loop with customer now. If anything else shows up I'll re-open thread.
